titles.A: How to Make Viral Instagram Reels with Canva + CapCut (Free & Beginner Friendly)
titles.B: Canva + CapCut Reels Tutorial: Design, Edit & Export the Right Way
titles.C: Why Your Reels Get No Views — the Canva + CapCut Fix (Full Tutorial)

title_notes: A = pure search intent ('viral instagram reels canva capcut') + free qualifier, matches how the channel's label/avatar videos are titled — recommend A. B = workflow-led for people searching the tool pairing. C = pain-point hook, better CTR if browse traffic outweighs search.
description_hook: Make a scroll-stopping Instagram Reel from scratch using Canva and CapCut — both free. Design the hook and animated slides in Canva, then beat-sync, caption and loop it in CapCut, and export it the one way that doesn't kill your reach on Instagram.

thumbnail.notes: Grab frames at: the finished reel playing (phone-frame moment), the CapCut beat-dot timeline, the Canva hook slide. Reel footage frame likely wins — it shows the outcome.
